# Tier 1 — Project Memory

## Workflow
- Invoice fixtures under tests/fixtures/invoices/ are the ground truth for payload shapes [seed, note 0].
- One route per resource; handlers stay thin, domain logic lives in src/domain/ [note 0].
- Maintain ESLint import-order rule: imports sorted alphabetically within each file [note 1].

## Known pitfalls
- Prefer standard library functions over hand-rolled logic [note 2].
- The express error handler returns 400 for validation failures, 500 otherwise [note 1].
- Zod schemas use .strict(); unknown keys are rejected [note 4].
- Zod validation errors map .flatten() output to 400 responses [note 5].

## Dependencies & Tooling
- Use axios for all outbound HTTP calls; leverage interceptors for retries and auth [note 7].
- Use winston for logging; ops dashboard ingests its format natively [note 9].
- Winston retry warnings: log axios retry events at warn level [note 10].

## Validation patterns
- Mirror related schemas (credit-note payloads follow invoice schema patterns) [note 6].
- All fixture cases must validate against schemas before merge [note 4, note 0].
